messages.subject: where is imputation done and what data is imputed?
parts:
Hi Pedro,

I am cc-ing my answer to the GGIR google group, because in that way I reduce the chance that I have to reply to the same question twice.

All - I am responding to GGIR questions on a voluntary basis now and then if I can find the time. If you or others want my exclusive support in your study then I am happy to do this as a paid consultancy. In that way you also support me in my ongoing efforts to maintain GGIR. That said, just as well welcome voluntary efforts to respond to user questions.

Regarding your question:

All steps related to taking into account study design, such as argument 'strategy', and the imputation of invalid data take place in part 2 of GGIR. I recommend using function g.shell.GGIR as that would avoid having to think which function argument needs to be set for which GGIR part.

If imputation is done (default) GGIR imputes all invalid data, which entails:
- non-wear
- time segments ignored because of study protocol, e.g. ignore first and last day.
- detected signal clipping, this should be very rare.

The GGIR reports come with columns that indicate the amount of valid/invalid data per day or per recording.

Thanks,
Vincent
